content: Kutama mulumule
Kuyene, munyighe Chapanga, nhwalo mangota ndi yana yake yaipala.
Ntame kwa kupalana ngita Kilichitu chatupahile na kupiya ughome gwake, ngita litambiko lilinungila petelele na litambiko lilinhalalicha Chapanga.
Nhwalo, mangota ndi yana ya Chapanga, ngongola na uhako ghoghoha ghola amu uloho ukotoka kujhokanikika pakate jhino ngita chiipalwa kwa bhando bha Chapanga.
Kabhele malobhe gha hone amu uwenje na malobhe ghanganandela, gheniya ghoha ghamaha jhe kwino kulonge. Ndi mbone nnongele malobhe gha kunchenguu Chapanga.

Umanyengane hotu ngongola jhojhoha amu jwahenga mambu gha hone anda jhe uloho ilenganile tela na kuijhinamila inyagho, amu mundo jhojhoha jwalandana na yenio najhingii ng'o munahota nkolongwa gwa Kilichitu na gwa Chapanga.
Mwangalogwa jhe kunnyeketela mundo jhojhoha kwa malobhe ghanganandela, kwa nhwalo gwa ilebhe ngita yenio lilaka lya Chapanga nalyahikila bhando bhangannyeketela.
Bhahe, nkotoka kubhehe maghumba nde na bheniya kwa kilebhe chochoha.
Makacho mangota mukibha mulubhendo tyoo, nambo ngoheno mangota mmii mulumule kwa kulombana na Bhambo. Ngohe ntamangane ngita yana ibhii mulumule,
nhwalo lumule luleta kuhenga ghaumbone na kujheketelwa na Chapanga na uchakaka.
Nghaghe kumanya ghala ghighanhalalicha Bhambo.
Mwangalombana mukuhenga ghanganandela ghighahuma mulubhendo nambo mughabheke pakongoloo.
Nhwalo ilebhe ibhahenga ajhito kwa chile hone kuichimulila.
Nambo ilebhe ihengeka mulumule, ubhonekana hotu,
nhwalo lumule lutenda kila kilebhe kibhonekane. Ndi nhwalo Majhandiko gha Chapanga ghilonge,

content.text: na jwenio Kilichitu namulikila kupala umanye.”

content: Ngohe, mukilolekeye chimitama. Pimitama nkotoka kubhehe ngita mandindilima, nambo ntame ngita bhando bhina malango.
Nkachane kutumii mbone kila pwache jhiminajho, nhwalo machiko ghanga ghamboni jhe.
Kwa nhwalo gwenio nkotoka kubhehe malindilima, nambo mughamanye ghala ghapala Bhambo.
Nkotoka kulobhela ughembe, nhwalo kulobhela kunnongocha kuhenga ghanganandela, nambo ntwelehenganwe Uhuke gwa Chapanga.
Nnongela malobhe gha Zabule na mihambo jha kunomba Chapanga. Munnyembele Bhambo, munhanganile kumiojho jhino.
Munombe Chapanga Tate machiko ghoha ghangapeta kwa nhwalo gwa ilebhe yoha, kwa liina lya Bhambo gwito Yecho Kilichitu.
Jwatolilwe na jwatolela
Kila mundo annyokanikiya nnyake kwa kuntembekeya Kilichitu.
Na mangota akakeghe majhokanikiya akangana bhino ngita chimunnnyekete Bhambo,
nhwalo akanalome ndi muto gwa nhwana mundo ngita Kilichitu chabhii muto gwa makunde gha bhando ghighanyeketii Kilichitu, na jwenio Kilichitu ndi nkomboche kwa bhando bhibhannyeketii yane yegha jhake.
Ngita makunde gha bhando ghighannyeketii Kilichitu chibhanyokanikiya Kilichitu, hele akakeghe bhajhokanikiya akangana bhabhe mughoha.
Na mangota akanalome, mapale akahana bhino ngita Kilichitu chalipala likunde lya bhando bhibhannyeketii jwenio, ade ngabhohita ughome gwake kwa nhwalo gwabhe.
Atehila yenio kulijhelebhula likunde lya bhando lilinyeketii Kilichitu palonge jha Chapanga, pajhomolila kwajhoha kwa lilobhe lyake ngita mundo jwaghololwa kwa mache.
Atehila naha akiletele jwenio likunde lya bhando lilinnyeketii jwenio lilibhii maha hake, lyangabhehe na mabaka amu ngenja amu ubhoho ghoghoha ghola, bhahe, nyahinyahi lyangabhehe na malemo.
Helahela kila munalome ampale nhwana mundo ngita chiipala yegha jhabhe bhene. Mundo jwampala nhwana mundo akipala jwenio.
Abhii jhe mundo jhojhoha jwaichimwa yegha jhake, nambo aupela chakulyegha na kukilonda. Ngita Kilichitu chalihengela likunde lya bhando lilinnyeketii Kilichitu jwenio,
nhwalo twenga ndi ihungo ya yegha yake.
Ngita hela Majhandiko gha Chapanga ghilonge, “Kwa nhwalo gwenio, munalome nabhaleka akanyongo mundo, na kulombana na nhwana mundo na bhabhele bheniya nabhabha yegha jhimo nde.”
Ubhii uchakaka ghuhiitwe kwa malobhe ghanga, nambo nenga nilonge malobhe ghanga kulangii malobhe gha Kilichitu na likunde lyake lilinnyeketile.
Nambo helahela kila munalome ipalwa ampale nhwana mundo ngita chakipala jwenio, na mwikeghe ipalwa hele annyokanikiya unganamundo.
